name: hero
description: Landing-page hero section composing badge + heading + description + call-to-action buttons, with an optional media column. Composition only: zero JavaScript, no controller, no reactive directives — the three layout variants (centred, split, and a full-bleed cover with display type over a backdrop) are pure CSS grid, and data-animate plays a staggered CSS entrance.

eyebrow.description: Short kicker above the headline — typically a nested data-ui='badge'

headline.description: The hero headline. Give it an id and point the section's aria-labelledby at it so the landmark is named

description.description: Supporting paragraph under the headline; capped at 42rem for readability

actions.description: Call-to-action row. Put nested data-ui='button' elements (or <a data-ui='button'>) directly inside; they keep their own data-variant/data-size and must NOT carry a data-part

note.description: Fine print under the actions (pricing caveat, trust line)

content.description: Text column wrapper — required by the split layout, omitted by the centered one

media.description: Media column of the split layout — typically a nested data-ui='image'. In the cover layout it is the backdrop BEHIND the words instead: a direct child of the section that absolutely fills it, holding one child that stretches to fill it — e.g. <figure data-ui='image' data-variant='cover' data-size='full'>, so the media element itself never carries a data-variant

--hero-bg.description: Background of the section (custom property). Set it to transparent when the hero sits inside a data-ui="backdrop".

animate.description: Play a staggered entrance on load: eyebrow, headline, description, actions, note and media each rise and fade in one --motion-stagger after the part before, on the theme's --motion-reveal-duration, --motion-reveal-ease and --motion-reveal-distance — whether the copy sits on the section or inside [data-part="content"]. In the cover layout the backdrop media settles first (a fade and a slight zoom-out) and the words arrive onto it. CSS keyframes with fill-mode both; reduced motion and print show every part already in place, so nothing is ever left hidden.

--hero-display-size.description: Font size of the cover layout's headline (custom property, cover only). Fluid by default between the type scale's largest step and three and a half times it; pass a clamp() or a size token to fix it.

--hero-scrim.default: a gradient from the bottom edge, --hero-bg at 92% fading to transparent
--hero-scrim.description: The layer between the cover's backdrop media and its words (custom property, cover only), there to hold the text's contrast over a photograph. Pass a background value; none removes it.

required_attrs: aria-labelledby on the section pointing at the headline id
alt text on any image inside the media slot
descriptive link text on every action (never 'click here')
a cover layout's backdrop photograph is still content to a screen reader unless it is decorative: give it real alt text, or alt='' when it only sets the mood

keyboard.Tab: move through the call-to-action links in source order

notes: Nested primitives inside a slot keep their own five-attribute contract. A nested element must not carry both data-part and data-variant: the pattern validates a part's data-variant against the *pattern's* variant values (center|split|cover), so a button's data-variant="primary" on a part would be a false mismatch. Put buttons inside [data-part="actions"] instead.
The centered layout is what `faqir scaffold landing-page` emits; the block between the <!-- @ui:scaffold landing-page --> markers in hero.html is copied into the generated page verbatim.

Inside a backdrop —
…
— the section goes transparent so the light shows. Wrap a few headline words in for the accent gradient.

The cover layout is the full-bleed opener: at least 88svh tall (88vh where svh is unknown), the words anchored to the bottom-start corner, and a fluid display headline (--hero-display-size) on the theme's heading role with tight leading, balanced lines and long words allowed to break, so it holds at 360px. Its media slot moves BEHIND the words — wrap the picture in a plain <div data-part="media"> and give the nested image data-variant="cover" data-size="full" — under a scrim of the section colour (--hero-scrim). Without media it is a tall, typographic hero; inside a data-ui="backdrop" with --hero-bg: transparent the light shows through it.

data-animate is the reveal primitive's stagger, re-stated on the hero's own parts: a reveal staggers its direct children and the copy may sit on the section or inside [data-part="content"], so the entrance is an option of the pattern, reading the same --motion-reveal-* and --motion-stagger tokens, with the same reduced-motion and print fallbacks as bento and testimonials. It plays on load rather than on scroll — a hero is above the fold.

changes.note: A cover layout value and a data-animate prop. cover is a full-bleed, near-full-viewport hero (min-block-size 88svh, 88vh fallback) with the words anchored to the bottom-start corner, a fluid clamp() display headline on the theme's heading role (--hero-display-size), and the media slot as a backdrop behind the words under a section-coloured scrim (--hero-scrim). Its inline gutter grows so the words start on the --measure-wide line the sections below sit on, and the display size eases down on a phone so a long uppercase word does not split. data-animate staggers eyebrow → headline → description → actions → note → media in on load with the --motion-reveal-* and --motion-stagger tokens (a cover's media settles first); reduced motion and print show everything at rest. Existing markup is unchanged.

A --hero-bg custom property: the section background, the page colour by default. A hero wrapped in a backdrop sets it transparent so the light behind shows through; a headline may hold a nested data-ui="highlight". Nothing else changes.

The responsive ladder moves onto the breakpoint canon, mobile-first (task 0.8-09). The sheet's max-width media blocks became min-width floors on canon tiers (sm 40rem/640px, md 48rem/768px, lg 64rem/1024px), so every unconditional rule is now the PHONE case and a tier block only ever widens it. The split variant gains its second column at lg and the action row becomes a row at sm. The floors keep their values, so the only behavioural shift is at exactly a floor: 1024px now gets the wide layout rather than the narrow one.
